spans.s:
Mulālin (masc.) or Mulālī (fem.) is the name of some part of an edible lotus (perhaps the Nymphaea esculenta) in the Atharvaveda.
Foot notes iv. 34. 5. Cf. kauśika sūtra, lxvi. 10; Weber, Indische Studien, 18, 138; Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 70; Whitney, Translation of the Atharvaveda, 207.
